chunks.content: eSanjeevani teleconsultation connects you to a government doctor by video or audio. Available at PHC/CHC or via the eSanjeevani app. For non-urgent NCD questions, book a teleconsult slot at your PHC. Operating hours: 9am to 5pm Mon-Sat.

For mild symptoms like slight headache, mild dizziness after BP medicine, or general NCD questions — use teleconsultation or visit PHC during working hours. Bring your medicine strip and previous prescription.

Go to hospital immediately if: chest pain lasting more than 5 minutes, sudden weakness on one side of body, difficulty speaking, severe breathlessness, or BP above 180/120 with symptoms. Call 108. Do not wait for teleconsultation for these symptoms.
If your PHC doctor refers you to a higher center, take the referral slip. PM-JAY empanelled hospitals accept government referrals for cashless treatment. Keep your Ayushman card and Aadhaar ready.
